fields.value: Not automatic; Tickets has the right to renew for another year during a 30-day period beginning 30 days before the first anniversary.

quotes.text:
Furthermore, for
a thirty (30) day period, beginning thirty (30) days prior to the first
anniversary of this Agreement, Tickets shall have the right to renew the
Agreement for another year with Sponsor Fees that do not exceed a [***] percent
increase over the existing Sponsor Fees.

payments.description: Late payment service fee of 1.5% per month on late payments under the Agreement.
payments.conditionNote: Applies only if a payment under the Agreement is late, and only to the extent allowed by law.

quotes.text:
Any late
payments under this Agreement will be assessed a service fee of one and one-half
percent (1.5%) per month, to the extent allowed by law.

ambiguities: Clause 3 limits the service fee "to the extent allowed by law," so the collectible fee may be less than 1.5% per month.

payments.description: If an audit shows MP3.com overstated Impressions by more than 5%, MP3.com must pay the audit cost and must refund Tickets.com, Inc. the overpaid difference or credit Impressions.
payments.conditionNote: Applies only if, for an applicable period, the independent auditor determines that MP3.com overstated the Count by more than 5%.

quotes.text:
If, for any applicable period, the independent auditor
determines that MP3.com overstated the Count by more than five percent (5%),
than MP3.com shall pay the cost of the Audit and shall refund Tickets the
difference between the amount originally paid and the amount which should have
been paid, or MP3.com shall credit the appropriate amount of Impressions to
Tickets' account.

ambiguities: Clause 5 gives MP3.com an alternative between refunding the difference and crediting Impressions, so a cash refund is not the only possible remedy.

payments.description: Each party must defend, indemnify and hold harmless the other and specified related persons for covered losses, costs, liabilities and expenses.
payments.conditionNote: Applies only when covered losses, costs, liabilities or expenses are incurred or arise from the listed matters.

quotes.text:
Each party agrees to defend, indemnify and hold harmless
the other and its shareholders, directors, officers, agents and employees for
any and all losses, costs, liabilities or expenses (including without limitation

reasonable attorneys' and expert witnesses' fees) incurred or arising from: (a)
any breach of the foregoing representations or warranties; (b) any claim arising
from the sale or license of either party's goods or services; or (c) any other
act, omission or representation by either party.

payments.description: In an action to enforce the Agreement, the prevailing party is entitled to costs and attorneys' fees.

ambiguities: The document does not state an express geographic territory; the grant is tied to the Website, so territoryCodes uses WORLD as a normalisation for lack of a geographic limitation.

Clause 4 gives Tickets a right to renew for another year, so the exclusivity could continue if renewed; the end date above uses the initial term because the document does not state that the renewal right was exercised.
